translations.web: I form the light and create darkness. I make peace and create calamity. I am Yahweh, who does all these things.
translations.bsb: I form the light and create the darkness; I bring prosperity and create calamity. I, the LORD, do all these things.
translations.kjv: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do
translations.asv: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil. I am Jehovah, that doeth all these things.
